title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 5–11 years (¥650bn anticipated) — the third print of the coupon-regime run, and the last mid-zone date on any published MOF calendar
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,186 bytes) by this event's own initial research and parsed row by row; the row reads 'Nov. 27, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 5-11 years)'. No November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09 — terms are due ~2026-11-20 on MOF's own 'about one week prior' note, printed at the foot of that calendar — so the ¥650bn size is ANTICIPATED, not announced, from MOF's run of twenty-five consecutive 'About 650 billion yen' announcement pages (auct*e.htm, 2024-08-22 through 2026-08-26, all read direct this session). The November slate carries the 1-5y zone (Nov. 20) and this 5-11y zone (Nov. 27) and NO super-long auction, exactly as the odd/even alternation across all 35 published calendars 2401e-2611e requires. It is the last mid-zone date any published calendar carries: 2612e.htm and 2701e.htm both 404 on 2026-09-09. Filed `estimate` on the standing counts — size not announced, issue list unpublished, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office
notes: Canonical file written 2026-09-09 by this event's never-assessed initial research, from the proposal `proposals/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-11-27.from-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22.json` (now shadowed). Two corrections to that proposal's own note, both from primary data: the 40-year auction is at D-2 (2026-11-25), not five days out; and the thin-global-bid confound it asked to be stated is NOT supported — across MOF's 458-print Liquidity Enhancement history (e-ryudousei_historical_data.xls, 2006-04-20 to 2026-07-28) the nine auctions falling in US Thanksgiving week printed cover 3.818 against 3.463 elsewhere and spread tails 0.222bp against 0.418bp (t = -2.44), i.e. stronger and significantly tighter, not softer. What this entry is actually for is stated in its ledger: it is the third print of the coupon-regime run (2026-09-25, 2026-10-22, then this one), it is the only mid-zone read in a month whose slate carries no super-long auction — so the family's cross-sector control has no November observation at all — and its ~2026-11-20 announcement scores a projected eligible-stock basis. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
